in:1551919780.idea_seed: AI-narrated serialized audio stories personalised to a Gen Z woman's mood or goal (confidence, heartbreak recovery, focus), with a Walk/Car mode and pay-per-episode credits instead of a subscription.

th:6778568911.what_it_is: Tongue-in-cheek stress-relief app of situational micro-rituals: tap a wooden block 108 times when angry, spin prayer beads when restless, walk with Buddha (steps from Apple Health), read one Buddha line a day, or open the app instead of your wallet when tempted to shop.
th:6778568911.sets_apart: Organised by emotional situation ('when rage boils up', 'when you can't face work', 'when the shopping demon visits') with a tactile micro-action and a joke for each, including an impulse-spend replacement ritual and walks tied to step data.
th:6778568911.lens_note: Playful mood-regulation rituals and soft habit loops fit K1. Buddhist theming is a skin and the tone is comedic rather than devotional (inference), but it is borderline for the religious-content exclusion.
th:6778568911.monetization: Free download; no pricing in the excerpt (IAP or subscription likely, inference).
th:6778568911.traction: 819 ratings (4.92) in TH in about 3 months since 2026-07-04; 50 US ratings (in US store); very fast early traction; developer has 3 apps.
th:6778568911.export_reason: Tap/haptic rituals are language-agnostic and easy to reskin (worry stone, bubble wrap, cute cat); Buddhist iconography needs a secular reskin for the US to avoid appropriation backlash (inference); 50 US ratings already show organic pull.
th:6778568911.idea_seed: A 'when X happens, do Y' emotional first-aid app for Gen Z women: pick a feeling (spiralling, cravings, shopping urge, can't start work) and get a 60-second tactile ritual with a cute companion, plus an 'open this instead of the shopping app' impulse-delay mode.
th:6778568911.build_components: Tap/haptic/sound interactions, bead-spin animation, daily quote content, HealthKit/Health Connect step sync, notifications, simple IAP; art and sound assets are the main work.
